text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — RansomShield legal just pinged asking for SIG question-by-question evidence. They want the mapping and artifacts by EOD Wednesday. Can we pull this together?
ben: I can start the mapping. Need to know which control IDs they care about (they highlighted encryption, key mgmt, and data residency).
raj: Put me on encryption/KMS answers. I have the KMS rotation policy and key lineage docs.
emily: I have the network segmentation diagram and VPC peering screenshots. Will upload links shortly.
mike: I'll export the Dedicated deployment audit logs for the past 12 months — that'll cover access controls and IAM evidence.
ben: Starting a matrix: Q1-Q200 mapping to artifacts. Will drop a CSV to S3 and share link.
olivia: Thanks. Also they asked specifically for how we handle KMS in Dedicated vs Private. Raj, can you include the per-environment KMS architecture note?
raj: Yes. Draft answer: "Customer-managed KMS available in Private; Hosted uses HSM-backed managed keys with rotation policy; Dedicated can be configured with customer KMS via VPC peering and customer KMS endpoint." Will attach the diagram.
emily: Uploaded network diagram here: https://s3.company.internal/ransomshield/network-diagram-v2.png :point_up:
sec-bot: Uploaded artifact "kms-rotation-policy-v3.pdf" to thread (artifact_id: art-8921).
mike: Audit export complete — s3://redwood-exports/ransomshield/sig/audit-export-2026-03-18.csv
ben: CSV with mapping uploaded: https://s3.company.internal/ransomshield/sig/question-mapping-1815550011.csv
olivia: Great, I'm drafting the cover note for the SIG package. Two asks before I send: 1) short plain-English explanation of our default key separation for multitenancy (one-liner), 2) confirmation of EU data residency options.
raj: One-liner: "We logically separate customer keys and use per-customer key namespaces; Dedicated/Private supports customer-provided keys for strict separation."
mike: EU residency confirmed — Dedicated can be pinned to eu-west-1; Private supports on-prem. I'll add region mapping doc link.
emily: Added screenshots of VPC peering config and subnet CIDRs to the S3 folder.
ben: Minor open item: SIG Q47 asks for list of subservice accounts with write access to S3 buckets. I'm pulling IAM policy snapshots.
olivia: Okay. If we hit blockers, escalate to legal. I want the package uploaded by Tue 18:00 to give them buffer.
raj: Filing a short sec summary for the cover note: https://docs.internal/redwood/sec/ransomshield-sig-summary.md
ben: Uploaded policy snapshot: https://s3.company.internal/ransomshield/sig/iam-snapshot-2026-03-18.json
olivia: Perfect. I'll assemble and send draft to @raj and @emily for quick review before sending to RansomShield. Thanks team :tada:
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: "SIG package review" in 18 hours
